question: Which restaurant can I find within 150 kilometers while progressing toward Lorimoto Gallery, Ridgewood, NY from Frick Madison, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.96399 40.773476)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.906362 40.697925)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.96399 40.773476)',4326)::geography, 150000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.96399 40.773476)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
